inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One infant classroom was out of ratio for around a minute while one caregiver left the room to get a child from the bus. This left the classroom with one caregiver and 5 infants under 12 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Provide care consistent with child's habits, interests, strengths, special needs, including any special supervision needs: One two year old child was in the hallway unattended and opening the door to come into the pre-k classroom where her mother was working. I
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: Based off investigation interviews it was determined that multiple classrooms were out of ratio due to staffing issues.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge: Staff did not know who was in charge of the operation at arrival on 8/13/26.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence - Qualified Caregiver in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant: This standard was found to be deficient. One caregiver admitted to placing the infant on their stomach to sleep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Infants Sleep on Backs or Must Have Completed and Signed Sleep Exception Form for the Infant (26 TAC §746.2427)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: One classroom was over ratio on 3 days for 10 minutes each day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: This standard was found to be deficient.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): Four out of ten staff files were missing the completed 2912 affidavit available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §746.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: The operation's policy is missing several items to include how to access minimum standards online.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website (26 TAC §746.501(a)(23))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: Two out of two infant teachers were missing SIDS/safe sleep required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One out of ten children's files did not have updated immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: One class out of six classes did not have a cot chart that identifies which cot belongs to each children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Two out of ten files were not updated and were missing health statements during the visit.   8/14/25-Two out of ten files were not updated and were missing health statements during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment: Three out of ten staff files did not have abuse and neglect required annual training available for review during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - 1 hour in Prevention, Recognition and Reporting of child maltreatment (26 TAC §746.1309(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials: There was not data/impact test available for review during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials (26 TAC §746.4913)

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records: Two out of ten files were not updated and were missing health statements during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Records (26 TAC §746.801(1))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name: The employee list posted was not updated during the visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - List entitled "Current Employees"--sized at least 81/2 X 11 inches, printed legibly, include employee first and last name (26 TAC §746.401(9))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: 9 out of 9 infant feeding schedules were either missing or not updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined that the operation failed to complete an incident report when a child was injured while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based on the information gathered during the investigation, it has been determined the operation failed to provide the parent with incident report when a child was injured in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Three out of eight infants did not have an infant feeding schedule available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: The required annual training were not avilable for review for five staff out of ten.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Report Change in Director: The operation failed to report within the required timeframe (5 days) a director is no longer at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Change in Director (26 TAC §746.303(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A staff member was present at the operation while having access to children while her background check status reflecting inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: When a child reported he was injured/hurt, he was not assessed further even after he was holding his arm against his body (favoring his arm) nor were the parents notified immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition: There was not enough popular items available in several classrooms for all the children. Shelves were observed less than half empty.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Enough Available to Prevent Competition (26 TAC §746.2505(2))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The floors had dust, trash, toys, toilet paper, etc on the floor during the walk thru in six out seven classrooms. The wall trim was off the wall in 4 year old class.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training: Four employees did not have required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: One employee did not have personnel records at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: Five children's files did not contain required information for Special Needs Care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: One child did not have required release information on file at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §746.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily: Infants are not allowed opportunities for outdoor play due to improper clothing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Outdoor Play Daily (26 TAC §746.2417(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Water Activity Permission: Five children's files did not have the required information for water activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: Two Children did not have completed food allery emergency plans in their files at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient. A young child walked out of a classroom and was walking around the center unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient. The caregiver did not show good judgment when they did not inform the parent about the severity of an injury a child sustained while in care. As a result, a child remained in care for 8 hours with a fractured finger.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient. A caregiver did not apply proper first aid for an injury that a child received while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Critical Injury - Give First Aid or CPR (26 TAC §746.3607(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left unattended or approximately 3-5 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children: Based on information gathered, it was determined that a young child was left unattended in a classroom for an undetermined period of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on information gathered, it was determined that the operation did not notify Licensing in the time frame required, that a young child was left unattended in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Based information gathered the operation did not notify parents in the required time frame that a young was left unattended in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Three  infants did not have updated written feeding instrutions in the infant room.
